title: Oscar and the Well
author: Freya Reyes
blurb: Mirabel Dunmore, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
